title: Lucas–Kanade
notes: Foundational 1981 image-registration/optical-flow algorithm, not a trained model. No contemporaneous author/CMU project page or official implementation was found; later teaching code and third-party implementations are excluded.

title: Horn–Schunck
notes: Classic variational optical-flow algorithm, not a trained model. No qualifying author/institution implementation was found; later reference and educational implementations are not official releases by Horn and Schunck.

title: Video Rewrite
notes: Legacy author-hosted project URL cited by the official Georgia Tech Video Textures page; it now returns 404 and should be treated as retired. No official source-code or model release was found.

title: Video Textures
notes: Official Georgia Tech page preserves paper links and recorded result highlights. No author/institution source release or model weights were found; the method reorders captured frames rather than using learned weights.

title: Dynamic Textures
notes: Paper and author materials identify this UCLA URL as the original data/movie page, but the legacy page is no longer available. No currently retrievable author implementation was confirmed; later MATLAB/Python versions are third-party.

title: Video (Language) Modeling
notes: Meta AI hosts an official publication record. No author/Meta training or inference repository, pretrained model, or interactive demo was found.

title: ConvLSTM
notes: No exact official implementation or pretrained checkpoint for the 2015 paper was found. The author-maintained HKO-7 repository belongs to the later 2017 TrajGRU/benchmark paper and is not labeled as the original ConvLSTM code.

title: Beyond MSE
notes: Official author Torch/Lua implementation. The ZIP is identified by the repository as containing two trained models and a UCF101 test subset; both result page and archive are legacy resources and may be intermittently unavailable.

title: Action-Conditional Video Prediction
notes: Official author project page and implementation. The page links a recorded qualitative video at https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=4e-PqfpS8_4, but no downloadable pretrained checkpoint or interactive demo was found.

title: DNA / CDNA / STP
notes: Official project page links the historical TensorFlow Models implementation. The directory was later removed from the current repository, so an immutable official snapshot is used; it is legacy TensorFlow 1.x and no official pretrained checkpoint was located.

title: PredNet
notes: Official Cox Lab project, code, and Keras-2 model archive. The project page contains result videos but no hosted interactive demo; the stack is now legacy Keras/TensorFlow.

title: Video Pixel Networks
notes: No DeepMind/author project page, source release, pretrained checkpoint, or demo specific to Video Pixel Networks was found. PixelCNN repositories and independent reproductions are not official.

title: SV2P
notes: Official project samples and TensorFlow Tensor2Tensor implementation. Tensor2Tensor was archived and made read-only in 2023; no official pretrained checkpoint catalog or interactive demo was found.

title: VGAN / Generating Videos with Scene Dynamics
notes: Official author project, Torch7 implementation, and 1 GB pretrained-model archive. Project videos are recorded generations rather than an interactive demo; the Drive link is a legacy download.

title: MoCoGAN
notes: Official author implementation with qualitative GIFs. No official pretrained checkpoint or interactive demo was found; PyTorch and Chainer reimplementations are third-party.

title: Video Generation from Text
notes: NEC Labs hosts an official publication/project record for this Duke/NEC work. No qualifying author/institution code, checkpoint, or interactive demo was found; similarly named repositories are reproductions.

title: SVG-LP
notes: Official author project and PyTorch repository. The repository includes pretrained SVG-LP models for BAIR and stochastic Moving MNIST; project samples are recorded outputs rather than an interactive demo.

title: Fréchet Video Distance
notes: Official Google Research reference implementation. The weights are the official I3D Kinetics-400 feature extractor used by the metric, not generative-model weights; no interactive FVD service was found.

title: DVD-GAN
notes: No qualifying DeepMind/author project page, implementation, pretrained checkpoint, or interactive demo was found. Public DVD-GAN repositories are third-party reproductions and are excluded.

title: VideoFlow
notes: Google Research publication and official Tensor2Tensor implementation. No separate project page was found. Tensor2Tensor was archived and made read-only in 2023; no official pretrained checkpoint or hosted demo was found.

title: VQ-VAE
notes: DeepMind's official Sonnet module and example notebook implement VQ-VAE, but they are not released paper checkpoints. The notebook is an executable official example rather than a hosted model endpoint.

title: VideoGPT
notes: Official author project and repository. The manifest provides Google Drive identifiers for four VQ-VAE and two VideoGPT checkpoints; the Colab is the official runnable demo. Community Hugging Face ports are not authoritative releases.

title: NÜWA
notes: Official Microsoft repository is an archived project/documentation repository with README material and assets, not training or inference implementation, so it is not Code. Official recorded examples: https://www.microsoft.com/en-us/research/articles/nuwa/.

title: CogVideo
notes: The historical CogVideo branch is the official 2022 release; the default branch now represents later CogVideoX work. Its download section links the official stage-1 and stage-2 archives. The AMiner demo may have regional/account constraints.

title: Phenaki
notes: Official Google Research project page provides recorded samples. The paper states that the underlying models were not released; no author/Google code, checkpoint, or interactive endpoint was found, and community implementations are not official.
